rural_agricultural.description: Areas primarily dependent on farming, animal husbandry, and allied activities.
rural_agricultural.demand: High demand for agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers), farm machinery repair, dairy processing, and cold storage.
rural_agricultural.rawMaterialSupply: Abundant local supply of crops, milk, and organic waste.
rural_agricultural.risks: Seasonal dependency on monsoons, price fluctuations in wholesale markets, and perishability of goods.

semi_urban_tier3.description: Small towns serving as hubs for surrounding villages.
semi_urban_tier3.demand: Growing demand for retail, FMCG, basic IT services, tailoring, two-wheeler repair, and fast food.
semi_urban_tier3.rawMaterialSupply: Moderate supply chain connectivity to larger cities.
semi_urban_tier3.risks: Increasing competition from larger brands, changing consumer preferences, and rent costs.

artisan_cluster.description: Villages or towns known for specific traditional crafts (e.g., weaving, pottery).
artisan_cluster.demand: Demand for modernized tools, packaging, direct-to-consumer online sales, and eco-friendly products.
artisan_cluster.rawMaterialSupply: Local availability of specialized raw materials (clay, yarn, wood).
artisan_cluster.risks: Dependence on middlemen, lack of modern marketing skills, and seasonal demand dips.
